## Outcome

What becomes possible or more reliable because of this change?

## System boundary

Which ingestion, storage, retrieval, agent, integration, or product boundary changed?

## Verification

- [ ] `bun run typecheck`
- [ ] `bun run test`
- [ ] `bun run build`
- [ ] Relevant E2E/live/evaluation checks
- [ ] Screenshots attached for visual changes

## Safety

- [ ] No secrets or private company content are included
- [ ] External tools remain read-only
- [ ] Failure, retry, deletion, and degraded states were considered
- [ ] Configuration remains centralized in `config/consts.json`
